title: Archestra / Guardrails & OpenAPPA
description: OpenAPPA hook and engine metrics from Archestra's Prometheus endpoint.

list.name: job
list.label: Scrape job
list.description: Prometheus target group: a set of monitored processes. Leave All to include every matching source.

panels.title: Dispatches in selected period
panels.description: Logical embedded OpenAPPA hook dispatches completed during the selected period, including errors. A dispatch is counted once after internal policy-revision retries.

panels.title: Failed dispatches in selected period
panels.description: Embedded hook dispatches that rejected with an error during the selected period. Structured deny and refuse decisions are counted separately.

panels.title: P95 tool-call hook duration
panels.description: 95th-percentile wall time of embedded tool-call hooks, including consult waits and internal retries. Shared batch preloading and principal lookup occur before this timer.

panels.title: Decisions / second
panels.description: Embedded hook dispatches per second by hook and returned decision. Lifecycle acknowledgments such as ack or context are not policy allows.

panels.title: Duration by hook (P95)
panels.description: 95th-percentile embedded dispatch wall time by hook. Consults, storage, and internal retries are included; this is not the duration of one policy rule.

panels.title: Structured denials and refusals
panels.description: Embedded dispatches returning deny_call, block, or refuse per second. These are structured outcomes rather than dispatch errors or unique denied user requests.

panels.title: Runtime boundary refusals
panels.description: Runtime crossings refused or held per second, grouped by reason. These are boundary events, not a count of unique conversations or all policy rule checks.

panels.title: Tool proposal decisions
panels.description: Embedded OpenAPPA tool-proposal decisions per second by outcome. A policy decision is distinct from a host hook acknowledgment.

panels.title: Policy check duration (P95)
panels.description: 95th-percentile embedded OpenAPPA policy-check duration, including failed evaluations. Collected from the same Archestra scrape as hook metrics.

panels.title: External consult outcomes
panels.description: Embedded helper, annotator, or authority consults per second by role and outcome.

panels.title: Remedy attempts
panels.description: Embedded OpenAPPA remedy attempts per second by outcome.

panels.title: Runtime failures by component
panels.description: Embedded OpenAPPA runtime failures per second by component and bounded error type.

panels.title: External consult duration (P95)
panels.description: 95th-percentile embedded external consult duration by role, in seconds.

panels.title: Remedy duration (P95)
panels.description: 95th-percentile embedded remedy duration by outcome, in seconds.
